title: Learning Agent-Centric Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.22880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent progress in integrating vision-language-action (VLA) models with world modeling has significantly advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by allowing systems to reason about imagined futures instead of merely reacting to current observations. However, most world VLA models generate future frames at the pixel level with plenty of dense visual tokens. Although such generated futures can be visually plausible, they preserve many driving-irrelevant appearance details, i.e., only a small portion of the tokens directly encode critical planning-relevant factors, such as agent geometry, motion dynamics, and interactions. translated_title: 面向自动驾驶的以智能体为中心的视觉-语言-动作世界模型学习
translated_abstract: 近期将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界建模相结合的研究进展，通过让系统能够对想象中的未来进行推理而非仅仅对当前观测作出反应，显著推动了端到端自动驾驶的发展。然而，大多数世界VLA模型是在像素层面生成未来帧，并包含大量密集的视觉标记。尽管这样生成的未来画面在视觉上可能很逼真，但它们保留了许多与驾驶无关的外观细节，也就是说，只有一小部分标记直接编码了关键的与规划相关的因素，例如智能体的几何结构、运动动态以及交互。这带来了显著的性能瓶颈。由此产生一个重要问题：世界VLA模型应该基于怎样的世界状态进行推理，以支持超越像素级预测的规划？我们主张，面向规划的世界建模应聚焦于一种紧凑且结构化的、以智能体为中心的潜在状态，该状态能够捕捉……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出面向规划的自动驾驶世界建模应聚焦于紧凑且结构化的以智能体为中心的潜在状态，而非像素级未来帧预测，从而解决现有世界VLA模型中大量视觉标记与驾驶规划无关所导致的性能瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that planning-oriented world modeling for autonomous driving should focus on a compact, structured agent-centric latent state rather than pixel-level future frame prediction, addressing the performance bottleneck caused by dense visual tokens encoding driving-irrelevant details in existing world VLA models.
